name: Preacher Curl (EZ-Bar)
summary: An EZ-bar curl with the upper arms supported on a sloped pad, which prevents cheating and keeps all the work on the biceps. This entry covers the EZ-bar version; the machine version follows the same technique.
setup: Adjust the seat so your armpits rest at the top of the pad and the upper arms lie flat on it.
Take the EZ bar with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Start with the arms almost fully extended and the chest against the pad.
execution: Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without lifting the elbows off the pad.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until the arms are nearly straight, stopping just short of a hard lockout.
cues: Slow and controlled on the way down
Stop short of a hard lockout
mistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom: lower slowly and stop with a slight elbow bend to protect the elbow.
Lifting the elbows or hips off the bench: lower the weight and keep contact with the pad.
Using too much weight: pick a load you can lower under control.
Bending the wrists: keep them in line with the forearms.
